scope: three orthographic views of a block with a hole and a step, projected by build123d, exported to DXF and read back with ezdxf, then one third-angle sheet with ezdxf dimensions and a title block, read back. A witness of the tool on a known solid, not a drawing of the head; docs/TOOLCHAIN.md assigns the tool on it
